Subject: Capacity alignment for upcoming closes — Dec week

Team —

Quick note ahead of our regular capacity huddle: BrightLeaf is tracking toward a close window that would require non-trivial dedicated capacity for their pilot -> GA ramp (see attached priority doc from RAO). I want us to lock the gating decisions before this Friday so sales can finalize the contract language for reserved slots and burst credits.

Top asks for this thread:
- Laura: updated per-week committed GPU-equivalent numbers for the next 8 weeks (per your model).
- Ben: any infra maintenance or pool constraints we need to bake into the plan (downtimes, reserved drains).
- Marissa: confirm if this opportunity needs special SLA/latency prioritization for the first 30 days of ramp.

Attachments I'll reference in the huddle: initial capacity model (capacity_model_v3.xlsx) and the deal priority PDF (deal_priorities_v2.pdf).

Proposed outcome: a simple carve plan (week ranges + GPUs) + finance gating item (discount / commit size) that sales can include in the SOW. Heads-up: BrightLeaf asked about a two-week hard start from contract execution.

If you can respond with numbers by midday today I'll synthesize before the huddle.

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — quick numbers from the model (attached: capacity_model_v3.xlsx). High level:

- Baseline (no burst): BrightLeaf pilot -> GA ramp expects ~2.5M generated tokens/week at peak which maps to ~6 x A100-equivalent GPUs sustained (service mix: 70% gen, 30% embeddings/ingest).
- Burst buffer recommendation: add 20% headroom for first 3 weeks of ramp for unpredictable traffic spikes => effective commit: 7.2 x A100-eq.
- Duration window: conservative close assumptions put heavy consumption weeks between 2026-12-28 and 2027-01-25.

If we assume Redwood provides a reserved pool for the commit and allows burst credit consumption charged to usage over commit, we should size the reserved slots to 6 and permit burst up to 2 GPUs for priority traffic. Finance will need to sign off on the pricing tier for that configuration (I put some numbers in the workbook).

Note: I've flagged two other near-term deals in the workbook that could push nominal demand up by ~10% if both accelerate — I marked them as low-probability.

Laura

Redwood Inference

Karthik / Laura —

A few infra constraints to call out before we finalize the carve plan:

1) Maintenance windows: we have a planned storage/node maintenance in the week of 2026-12-27 that will reduce available serving slots by ~12% for a 36-hour block. I'm pushing to shift to the preceding week but it's not confirmed. See infra_constraints.txt for the maintenance note and tentative schedule.

2) Early-Jan driver patch: a GPU driver patch is scheduled in the 2nd week of Jan that currently targets non-production clusters but there's a small chance it touches one of the smaller dedicated pools unless we explicitly exclude them. That would risk short latency spikes.

Mitigations I'm proposing:
- Prioritize BrightLeaf's latency-sensitive endpoints onto the primary reserved slots; route lower-priority background jobs to on-demand preemptible capacity or batch pipelines during the 36-hour maintenance window.
- Hold a 15-min tech gating call with Infra on Thu to lock exclusions; I can set that up.

I'll attach the infra constraints stub as requested.

Ben

Redwood Inference

Thanks all — great inputs. Summary / action items we agreed on during the sync and in thread: 

1) Carve plan (tentative): allocate 6 reserved A100-equivalent slots to BrightLeaf for 2026-12-28 through 2027-01-15. Allow up to +2 GPU burst credits for the first 3 ramp weeks. (Owner: Karthik)
2) Infra exclusions: Ben to confirm exclusion for the reserved pool from the 2026-12-27 maintenance window or move maintenance. If exclusion not possible, we will shift start to 2026-12-21 to avoid the 36-hour block. (Owner: Ben)
3) Finance gating: Marissa to confirm discount tier for 6-slot reserved commit and whether accounting requires a minimum 3-month commitment to book revenue. (Owner: Marissa)
4) Contract language: Sales (Karthik) to include explicit burst credit policy and guaranteed start window in SOW; Sarah please confirm BrightLeaf can accept the two-week start requirement or needs a faster start. (Owner: Sarah)
5) Follow-up: 15-min infra gating call scheduled Thu 2026-12-17 09:30 PT (invite to follow). After that we'll lock the final carve and circulate a one-page carve + pricing summary to legal/finance.

Attached: deal_priorities_v2.pdf (deal priority memo). I'll push the consolidated carve table into the drive link and HubSpot (see related links).
